policy: Set before any indirect-light producer is optimized (AGENTS.md: budgets before optimization). Runners report each producer's measured cost against its row; a producer over budget on a profile is declared unsupported there, never enabled silently. A missing measurement leaves the row unverified. Rows are per producer; the switching fade's peak memory is the sum of both producers' rows plus the published volume.

measurement.cpu_ms_per_update: wall time of one producer update on the frame executor, median over the scenario's warm frames
measurement.gpu_ms: producer passes' GPU time from timestamp queries, median over warm frames
measurement.memory_mb: producer-owned CPU plus GPU allocations at steady state, excluding the lightmap
measurement.update_hz: producer updates per second the budget is measured at

baseline.scenario: portal frame-pacing scenario, warm pass, 3 runs

sdf.status: unsupported until measured within a budget (RFC 0011 G6.4)

rayquery.status: unsupported until the device query and a measurement (RFC 0011 G7.3)

macos-arm64-client.status: no runner (R29); the rows are the Android rows until an Apple measurement replaces them

ios-arm64-device.status: no runner (R29); the rows are the Android rows until an Apple measurement replaces them
